data.body:
CLOSE EVIDENCE — all five acceptance criteria re-verified against the MERGED tree. Worktree HEAD
== origin/main == d49fea41cc38; commit 10533b1e3f65 ("Guard the terraform canary against pre-gate
trees", Gerrit 2676) confirmed an ancestor of HEAD by `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, and
`rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev 10533b1e3f65` resolves d3d3-63b0-3f5d-4f93.

AC1 — no `predates-gate-ok` marker in the canary job. MET.
  `grep -n "predates-gate-ok" .github/workflows/_optionality.yml` returns NO lines at all — the
  false marker is gone from the whole file, not merely from that job.

AC2 — the step guards the test path with `[ -f ]` and the canonical skip message, ahead of the
  pip install. MET. Within the terraform-config-inspect-canary job, in order:
    if [ ! -f tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py ]; then
        … "(change predates the gate) — skipping;" …
        exit 0
    fi
    python -m pip install --upgrade pip
  so a pre-gate tree pays for no installs. `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py -q`
  -> 9 passed in 76.93s, which covers BOTH halves of the invariant: the completeness check and
  test_empty_tree_every_guarded_step_skips_cleanly.

AC3 — RED evidence recorded. MET, in the earlier comment on this ticket. With the marker deleted
  and no guard added, the repo's own owner of this invariant failed and named this exact step:
    test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked
    E  .github/workflows/_optionality.yml :: [terraform-config-inspect-canary]
       'Run the opt-in pinned canary' runs tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py
       with no `-f` guard and no marker
    1 failed, 8 passed
  So the guard test detects it; only the marker had been keeping it quiet.

AC4 — empty tree skips cleanly, real tree does not. MET, re-run live just now by extracting the
  merged step body from the YAML and executing it:
    EMPTY TREE  rc=0  skip_message_printed=True
                "tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py not in checked-out tree
                 (change predates the gate) — skipping; the gate re-enforces on rebase and on
                 every post-merge change"
    REAL TREE   rc=0  fell_through=True  took_skip_branch=False
  So the canary keeps full teeth on every current tree; the guard only fires where the file is
  genuinely absent.

AC5 — make verify green before push. MET — 19950 passed, 25 skipped in 31m32s, exit 0, zero
  FAILED lines, on the three-commit stack whose tree hash is byte-identical to what was pushed.

Closing class: plan_defect. The step carried a `# predates-gate-ok:` marker asserting "the job and
this test file are introduced together, so the lane never runs against an older base". That
assertion is false on the Verified lane, which by design runs workflows from trusted `main`
against the patchset tree — a property `gerrit-verify.yaml` documents in its own header at lines
23-27. Nothing regressed and nothing was environmental: the original change reasoned from an
invariant the system does not provide, so the defect is in the plan itself.
